calculation.description: Fades unusually weak or strong intraday closes, scaling the reversal signal by abnormal current VIX stress. CLV is close location within the daily high-low range; positive scores indicate expected relative outperformance. All inputs are lag-safe and use the observation-only VIX solely as a conditioning signal.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (0.0855643), 2023-2024 (0.0570128), and 2025-2027 (0.0442139); uncertainty is material because the cross-section averages 11.3 instruments.
